assets.title: Type Six: uncertainty, support, and a revisable trust hypothesis
assets.answer_first: Type Six is a traditional Enneagram hypothesis about attention returning to uncertainty, trusted support, possible problems, and workable contingency plans. Questions, caution, loyalty, or doubt cannot establish motive because real risk, governance duties, discrimination, trauma-related safety, resource precarity, and recent failures can create the same behavior.

sections.heading: Observe uncertainty without turning caution into identity
sections.body: Track which unknown receives attention, what evidence permits action, whose support is consulted, and whether a contingency plan closes the question. Record changes across stakes rather than assuming a permanent vigilance style.

sections.heading: Separate questions and loyalty from inferred motive
sections.body: A colleague may ask for detail because the contract is unclear, the system failed before, or responsibility is unequal. Loyalty may reflect affection, ethics, livelihood, mutual aid, or a freely renewed commitment rather than type.

sections.heading: Compare checking, commitment, and repair
sections.body: In decisions, note whether alternatives clarify action or keep reopening it. During feedback, record how authority and evidence are weighed; in conflict, observe whether concerns are named, support is requested, and agreements are tested fairly.

sections.heading: Hold preparedness beside its coordination costs
sections.body: Uncertainty attention may support risk detection, accountable planning, solidarity, and noticing weak assumptions. Tradeoffs appear when low-probability threats dominate, reassurance expires immediately, or every disagreement becomes a test of trust.

sections.heading: Use stakes and power to interpret behavior
sections.body: At work, compare a safety officer escalating a required hazard with a teammate rechecking a reversible choice. In a relationship, compare clarifying an agreement with repeatedly testing commitment. Actual duties and consent change the meaning.

sections.heading: Compare modifiers and contextual alternatives
sections.body: The 6w5 hypothesis adds evidence, analysis, and private preparation; 6w7 adds options, social coordination, and active experimentation. Also compare Five research, Seven option seeking, anxiety, legal duty, unsafe environments, discrimination, and institutional mistrust.

sections.heading: Look for trust that updates with evidence
sections.body: The hypothesis weakens when adequate evidence ends checking, support is accepted without repeated tests, uncertainty is carried through a reversible action, and authority is questioned or followed according to transparent reasons rather than reflex.

sections.heading: Keep trust language non-diagnostic and voluntary
sections.body: Use this page to examine uncertainty, support, checking, and contingency planning. It cannot diagnose anxiety or trauma, certify loyalty, assess security clearance, screen applicants, predict conduct, or fix a person's identity.

faqs.question: Does cautious questioning establish Type Six?
faqs.answer: No. Legal duties, unsafe conditions, prior failures, unequal accountability, discrimination, or an unclear brief can require careful questions. Compare whether checking updates when evidence and responsibility change.

faqs.question: Why separate loyalty from a type hypothesis?
faqs.answer: Loyalty can reflect love, ethics, livelihood, reciprocity, community survival, or a freely renewed promise. Observe consent, alternatives, and power before using a personality explanation.

faqs.question: What evidence should weaken the uncertainty hypothesis?
faqs.answer: Checking that ends with sufficient evidence, comfortable reversible action, support accepted without repeated tests, and reason-based responses to authority should all reduce confidence.

observation_exercise.context: Across five days, choose one low-stakes choice, one governed decision, and one trust conversation.
observation_exercise.observable_signal: Record actual consequence, missing evidence, consulted support, authority role, contingency plan, decision time, and later update.
observation_exercise.page_specific_signal: Compare whether checking stops when a named evidence threshold is met and the next step remains reversible.
observation_exercise.alternative_explanation: Check legal duty, resource precarity, discrimination, recent failure, trauma safety, power, and unclear ownership.
observation_exercise.reflection_prompt: Name the event where transparent reasons best explain action and revise the Type Six hypothesis downward.

assets.title: 6w5: a core-first hypothesis about evidence, analysis, and private preparation
assets.answer_first: 6w5 is an evidence-limited wing hypothesis: Type Six uncertainty, support, trust, and contingency concerns remain primary, while the adjacent type may modify attention toward evidence, analysis, and private preparation. The pattern does not establish 6w5 because research training, technical review, confidentiality, regulated analysis, and specialist roles can require the same behavior.

sections.heading: Keep Type Six primary before adding a modifier
sections.body: Establish recurring Type Six uncertainty, support, trust, and contingency observations first; Consider source quality, failure modes, and private preparation only as a secondary modifier after research training, specialist work, audit duties, regulated analysis, and a recent technical failure no longer explains the behavior.

sections.heading: Compare 6w5 with 6w7 on one uncertain task
sections.body: Give 6w5 and 6w7 the same incomplete task with matched consequence, deadline, and decision rights; Compare how source quality, failure modes, and private preparation differs from 6w7 option testing and group coordination in moving the work forward.

sections.heading: Observe choices, handoffs, and stopping rules
sections.body: Across a technical review, confidential handoff, and low-stakes choice, record requested information, consulted people, option narrowing, action time, and stopping rule; Separate a voluntary strategy from a required procedure.

sections.heading: Use flexible low-stakes action as a challenge
sections.body: Reduce confidence when the person comfortably uses running a timely group experiment, sharing unfinished analysis, and accepting a competent colleague's conclusion; count these events as real counterexamples rather than exceptions to 6w5.

sections.heading: Audit learned work and environmental demands
sections.body: research training, specialist work, audit duties, regulated analysis, and a recent technical failure can teach the same response; Audit accountability, resources, safety, culture, and recent events before retaining a wing explanation.

sections.heading: Keep the modifier secondary and evidence-limited
sections.body: 6w5 is not a separate type, competence rating, loyalty measure, or conduct forecast; Wing research remains limited, so the modifier stays secondary and disconfirmable.

faqs.question: Does evidence, analysis, and private preparation prove 6w5?
faqs.answer: No; research training, specialist work, audit duties, regulated analysis, and a recent technical failure may require source quality, failure modes, and private preparation; Compare behavior after duty, consequence, and role requirements change rather than typing from one task.

faqs.question: How should 6w5 be compared with 6w7?
faqs.answer: Keep the Type Six core, information gap, consequence, and deadline constant; Then compare source quality, failure modes, and private preparation with 6w7 option testing and group coordination and record whether the role determines the difference.

faqs.question: What evidence weakens the 6w5 modifier?
faqs.answer: Comfortably running a timely group experiment, sharing unfinished analysis, and accepting a competent colleague's conclusion, followed by stopping at a reasonable threshold, should lower confidence in the 6w5 modifier.

assets.title: Type Six self-preservation: a practical safety, warm alliances, and resource continuity hypothesis
assets.answer_first: Type Six self-preservation is a traditional subtype hypothesis about attention to practical safety, warm alliances, and resource continuity. This pattern does not establish subtype because scarcity, housing insecurity, disability access, caregiving, unsafe work, and mutual-aid needs may shape the same behavior. Matched resource access, practical stakes, consent, and household power guide this comparison.

sections.heading: State the tradition as a secondary testable idea
sections.body: Within a Type Six core hypothesis, this subtype may emphasize practical safety, dependable resources, and warm alliances; Check material and relational conditions first, then keep it secondary and revisable.

sections.heading: Use matched situations before interpreting the pattern
sections.body: Use similar workloads across a resource-secure period and an access-constrained period; Record whether support, rule response, or challenge changes when the matched condition changes.

sections.heading: Reject bodily and neurological mechanism claims
sections.body: The self-preservation label organizes resource-continuity observations; it is not evidence about bodily mechanisms, neural systems, fixed functions, or a universal biological category.

sections.heading: Allow behavior that looks unlike the stereotype
sections.body: The person may show hosting, sharing, or visible calm; Visible style therefore cannot prove or disprove the subtype hypothesis.

sections.heading: Audit material, institutional, and relational conditions
sections.body: scarcity, housing insecurity, disability access, caregiving, unsafe work, migration, and mutual-aid obligations can shape the same response; Address these realities directly rather than translating them into personality essence.

sections.heading: Use changed conditions as a disconfirmation test
sections.body: Lower confidence when the record shows flexible sharing after replenishment, support from several people, and relaxed limits when scarcity ends, and preserve the environmental account as a live alternative.

sections.heading: Keep subtype inference local and non-predictive
sections.body: Instrument-specific evidence cannot establish universal subtype ontology or cross-cultural equivalence, and this page cannot forecast safety, resource sufficiency, or future conduct.

assets.title: 第六型：不确定性、支持与信任更新的可修正假设
assets.answer_first: 第六型是九型人格中的传统观察假设，关注点可能反复落在不确定性、可信支持、潜在问题与可执行预案上。提问、谨慎、忠诚或怀疑不能证明动机，因为真实风险、治理职责、歧视处境、创伤安全、资源不稳与近期故障都可能形成相似表现。本页直接说明不确定支持问题如何观察、谨慎忠诚怀疑如何比较，以及真实风险治理歧视如何核对。

sections.heading: 记录未知事项怎样获得优先级
sections.body: 观察哪个未知最受关注、什么证据足以行动、向谁寻求支持，以及预案是否真的关闭问题。要跨不同后果比较，不把一次谨慎写成恒定警觉。

sections.heading: 把提问与忠诚放回具体责任
sections.body: 合同不清、系统曾失败或责任不平等都会增加提问；忠诚也可能来自感情、伦理、生计、互助或自愿续订的承诺。必须记录当事人的理由与退出空间。

sections.heading: 比较核对、承诺与修复过程
sections.body: 决定中观察备选方案是推动行动还是不断重开问题；反馈中记录怎样权衡权威和证据；冲突中核对是否明确担忧、请求支持并公平检验协议。

sections.heading: 同时看到准备能力与协调成本
sections.body: 关注不确定性可能支持发现风险、负责规划、互助和识别薄弱假设。代价可能是低概率威胁占满注意、安慰很快失效，或把每次分歧都变成信任测试。

sections.heading: 用后果与权力区分同样动作
sections.body: 工作中要区分安全负责人上报法定隐患与同事反复核对可逆选择；关系中要区分澄清协议与持续测试承诺。职责、同意和权力会改变解释。

sections.heading: 比较翼型修饰与现实替代项
sections.body: 6w5 假设增加证据、分析和私下准备，6w7 假设增加选项、社交协调和主动试验。还应比较第五型研究、第七型寻路、现实焦虑、法律职责、不安全环境与制度失信。

sections.heading: 寻找证据到位后能够更新的信任
sections.body: 如果充分证据能结束核对、支持被接受而不反复测试、当事人能带着未知做可逆行动，并依据透明理由回应权威，就应下调第六型假设。

sections.heading: 不把信任变成诊断或忠诚认证

faqs.question: 谨慎提问可以直接判断第六型吗？
faqs.answer: 不能。法律职责、不安全条件、既往故障、不平等问责、歧视或模糊任务都会要求谨慎提问；应观察证据和责任变化后核对是否同步更新。

faqs.question: 为什么忠诚必须与类型假设分开？
faqs.answer: 忠诚可能来自感情、伦理、生计、互惠、社群生存或自愿承诺。比较时必须记录同意、可选方案、退出成本与权力，不能从持续关系反推动机。

faqs.question: 哪些反例会削弱不确定性假设？
faqs.answer: 证据充分后停止核对、能做可逆行动、接受支持而不反复测试，并依据清楚理由回应权威，都会削弱把谨慎归因于类型的判断；复盘时还应记录真实后果、决定权限与支持是否持续可用。

assets.title: 第六型自保副型：实际安全、温暖联盟与资源连续的假设
assets.answer_first: 第六型自保副型是传统二级假设，关注点可能落在实际安全、温暖联盟与资源连续。这种表现不能证明副型，因为资源稀缺、住房不稳、无障碍需要、照护责任、危险工作与互助需要都可能塑造相同行为。本页直接说明实际安全、温暖联盟与资源连续如何观察、资源稀缺、住房不稳、无障碍需要、照护责任、危险工作与互助需要如何比较，以及后果资源同意权力如何匹配。

sections.heading: 把传统说法转成可检验二级观察
sections.body: 在第六型核心成立的前提下，该副型可能强调实际安全、可靠资源与温暖联盟；先核对现实条件，再把它作为次要且可撤销的观察。

sections.heading: 先匹配情境再解释表现
sections.body: 使用工作量相近的资源稳定期与进入受限期进行比较，记录条件变化后支持、规则或挑战方式是否同步更新。

sections.heading: 拒绝身体与神经机制推断
sections.body: 就资源连续与实际安全观察而言，它不描述身体机制，也不讨论神经组织或恒定功能；该标签不能证明普遍生物类别。

sections.heading: 允许不符合刻板印象的外显风格
sections.body: 当事人可能表现为接待他人、主动共享或外显放松，因此外显风格不能单独证实或否定这个副型假设。

sections.heading: 先审计物质、制度与关系条件
sections.body: 稀缺、住房不稳、无障碍需要、照护、危险工作、迁移与互助义务都会塑造相似反应；这些现实问题应先得到直接处理，不能被改写成人格本质。

sections.heading: 用条件变化主动寻找反例
sections.body: 如果出现补充后灵活共享、接受多来源支持并在稀缺结束后放松边界，就应降低该副型假设的信心，并保留环境解释。

sections.heading: 把副型推断限制在本地观察
sections.body: 量表特定证据不能证明普遍副型本体或跨文化等价性，本页也不用于推断安全、资源充足或未来行为。

faqs.question: 实际安全、温暖联盟与资源连续能够直接证明这个副型吗？
faqs.answer: 不能。稀缺、住房不稳、无障碍需要、照护、危险工作、迁移与互助义务都可能形成实际安全、可靠资源与温暖联盟；必须先匹配现实后果、机会、职责、同意与权力。

faqs.question: 怎样设计第六型自保副型的公平比较？
faqs.answer: 使用工作量相近的资源稳定期与进入受限期，并记录条件变化以后可观察行为是否同步改变，才能进行相对公平的比较。比较时还要记录补充资源到位的时间与支持来源是否改变。

faqs.question: 资源恢复后的哪些反例会削弱安全连续假设？
faqs.answer: 补充后灵活共享、接受多来源支持并在稀缺结束后放松边界都属于正式反例，应降低副型解释的置信度，而不是被视为偶然。每个反例都应注明稀缺是否结束以及边界怎样实际放松。

assets.title: 第六型社群副型：职责、规则、权威与角色清晰的假设
assets.answer_first: 第六型社群副型是传统二级假设，关注点可能落在职责、规则、权威与角色清晰。这种表现不能证明副型，因为法律要求、职业层级、制度风险、不平等问责、歧视与公共责任都可能塑造相同行为。本页直接说明职责、规则、权威与角色清晰如何观察、法律要求、职业层级、制度风险、不平等问责、歧视与公共责任如何比较，以及后果资源同意权力如何匹配。

sections.heading: 把传统说法转成可检验二级观察
sections.body: 在第六型核心成立的前提下，该副型可能强调清楚职责、正当规则与可问责权威；先核对现实条件，再把它作为次要且可撤销的观察。

sections.heading: 先匹配情境再解释表现
sections.body: 使用后果相近的透明同伴治理与不透明职位层级中的同一规则进行比较，记录条件变化后支持、规则或挑战方式是否同步更新。

sections.heading: 拒绝身体与神经机制推断
sections.body: 就规则、职责与权威观察而言，它不描述身体机制，也不讨论神经组织或恒定功能；该标签不能证明天生服从系统。

sections.heading: 允许不符合刻板印象的外显风格
sections.body: 当事人可能表现为公开质疑领导、灵活处理或参与非正式群体，因此外显风格不能单独证实或否定这个副型假设。

sections.heading: 先审计物质、制度与关系条件
sections.body: 法律、执照、职业层级、公共职责、歧视、举报风险与不平等问责都会塑造相似反应；这些现实问题应先得到直接处理，不能被改写成人格本质。

sections.heading: 用条件变化主动寻找反例
sections.body: 如果出现没有正式角色也能工作、按公开理由调整规则并共享权威，就应降低该副型假设的信心，并保留环境解释。

sections.heading: 把副型推断限制在本地观察
sections.body: 量表特定证据不能证明普遍副型本体或跨文化等价性，本页也不用于推断服从、领导、公民行为或制度适配。

faqs.question: 职责、规则、权威与角色清晰能够直接证明这个副型吗？
faqs.answer: 不能。法律、执照、职业层级、公共职责、歧视、举报风险与不平等问责都可能形成清楚职责、正当规则与可问责权威；必须先匹配现实后果、机会、职责、同意与权力。

faqs.question: 怎样设计第六型社群副型的公平比较？
faqs.answer: 使用后果相近的透明同伴治理与不透明职位层级中的同一规则，并记录条件变化以后可观察行为是否同步改变，才能进行相对公平的比较。比较时还要记录规则理由是否公开以及拒绝会承担什么代价。

faqs.question: 取消正式角色后的哪些反例会削弱权威职责假设？
faqs.answer: 没有正式角色也能工作、按公开理由调整规则并共享权威都属于正式反例，应降低副型解释的置信度，而不是被视为偶然。每个反例都应注明职位变化与共享决定权怎样影响回应。

assets.title: 第六型一对一副型：直接挑战、勇气展示与检验威胁的假设
assets.answer_first: 第六型一对一副型是传统二级假设，关注点可能落在直接挑战、勇气展示与检验威胁。这种表现不能证明副型，因为真实危险、自卫训练、歧视、骚扰、竞赛规则、创伤安全与权力不平等都可能塑造相同行为。本页直接说明直接挑战、勇气展示与检验威胁如何观察、真实危险、自卫训练、歧视、骚扰、竞赛规则、创伤安全与权力不平等如何比较，以及后果资源同意权力如何匹配。

sections.heading: 把传统说法转成可检验二级观察
sections.body: 在第六型核心成立的前提下，该副型可能强调直接挑战、勇气展示与回应感知威胁；先核对现实条件，再把它作为次要且可撤销的观察。

sections.heading: 先匹配情境再解释表现
sections.body: 使用危险、同意、退出机会、权力与训练相匹配的两次紧张互动进行比较，记录条件变化后支持、规则或挑战方式是否同步更新。

sections.heading: 拒绝身体与神经机制推断
sections.body: 就直接挑战与感知威胁观察而言，它不描述身体机制，也不讨论神经组织或恒定功能；该标签不能证明天生战斗或配对反应。

sections.heading: 允许不符合刻板印象的外显风格
sections.body: 当事人可能表现为轻声表达、离开、寻求帮助或间接抵抗，因此外显风格不能单独证实或否定这个副型假设。

sections.heading: 先审计物质、制度与关系条件
sections.body: 真实危险、骚扰、歧视、自卫训练、竞赛规则、创伤安全与权力不平等都会塑造相似反应；这些现实问题应先得到直接处理，不能被改写成人格本质。

sections.heading: 用条件变化主动寻找反例
sections.body: 如果出现安全场景中平静协商、自然退出并在危险匹配后不重复挑战，就应降低该副型假设的信心，并保留环境解释。

sections.heading: 把副型推断限制在本地观察
sections.body: 量表特定证据不能证明普遍副型本体或跨文化等价性，本页也不用于推断勇气、攻击性、匹配、忠诚或关系结果。

faqs.question: 直接挑战、勇气展示与检验威胁能够直接证明这个副型吗？
faqs.answer: 不能。真实危险、骚扰、歧视、自卫训练、竞赛规则、创伤安全与权力不平等都可能形成直接挑战、勇气展示与回应感知威胁；必须先匹配现实后果、机会、职责、同意与权力。

faqs.question: 怎样设计第六型一对一副型的公平比较？
faqs.answer: 使用危险、同意、退出机会、权力与训练相匹配的两次紧张互动，并记录条件变化以后可观察行为是否同步改变，才能进行相对公平的比较。比较时还要记录安全恢复后能否无代价地离开现场。

faqs.question: 安全恢复后的哪些反例会削弱直接挑战假设？
faqs.answer: 安全场景中平静协商、自然退出并在危险匹配后不重复挑战都属于正式反例，应降低副型解释的置信度，而不是被视为偶然。每个反例都应注明危险、权力与退出机会是否已经匹配。
